# Add structured observability for password reset flows

## Summary

Emit structured logs for forgot-password requests, Resend send outcomes, token validation categories, and successful resets—without logging reset tokens, raw secrets, or plaintext passwords.

## Scope

- In scope: Log events at key points in TICKET-003 and TICKET-004 code paths; failure reason categories for invalid/expired/reused tokens; success correlation via non-PII identifiers where useful (e.g. request id).
- Out of scope: New external APM vendor; PII-heavy access logs.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Request received (forgot) logged with safe metadata (REQ-007).
- [ ] Email send result logged as success/failure without message body or API key (REQ-007).
- [ ] Token validation failures logged by category (expired, invalid, used) without raw token (REQ-007).
- [ ] Successful password reset completion logged without password or token material (REQ-007).
- [ ] Spot-check: no plaintext password or raw token in log lines for covered paths.

## Dependencies

- Depends on: TICKET-003, TICKET-004
- Blocks: none

## Notes

Can ship shortly after core P0; avoid duplicate logging noise (one line per stage).
